rationale: The first reply ignored the customer's explicit refusal and told her to 'unscrew the filter just a little', only pivoting to the drain hose after she pushed back; it then correctly found and fixed the squashed hose and used the hum/rattle evidence sensibly. However it never explained the small emergency drain tube for controlled draining, never asked whether someone else (e.g. a family member) could clean the filter, and escalated straight to an engineer while asserting the object was 'lodged deep in the pump housing that you can't reach from the outside' - speculative, since the filter was never checked. No parts recommended and basic isolation was given, but the escalation was premature and alternatives were missed.
